text: My daily routine is built on consistency. I wake up at six every morning, and my first habit is drinking a glass of water before making coffee. After a quick shower, I review my schedule for the day. Work starts at nine, and I usually focus on my most challenging tasks before lunch. Around five in the afternoon, I exercise for thirty minutes—either a jog in the park or a yoga session at home. Evenings are for preparing a simple dinner and reading a chapter of a book. By ten-thirty, I’m in bed. This regular pattern keeps me productive and calm.
